carried.from: the probes bp.m and pad.m (an Apple M3 Max, macOS 27.0.1)

times.measured: 8 round(s) of the whole selection, in the case set's own order, each round on a fresh device, our shader cache carried over between the cases of a round; a figure is the median of the rounds' own medians; Metal's leg ran at a one-minute load average of 4.12 and ours at 4.12; the legs run one after the other, so the per-call margin is judged only when both are 26.0 or under and within 2.0x of each other

times.stopped: the case forbids running its Metal leg here: the fill goes through fillTexture:/fillTextureColor:, which are Apple SPI, so no public call exists to record it from; the two-plane extended-range formats themselves are public, and the cases here that run no fill do record on Metal
